0.original: <hex:024804F201FC03><hex:024904F201FD03> Quest Sync<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103><hex:02100103>The young Arkasodara is staring off into the jungle with worry in his eyes.

24.original: With the chat mode in <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Say<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, enter any phrase containing “Sushena” to call out for him.

26.original: Use the healing salve on Sushena.

48.original: Ah, excuse me, but you're a traveler, yes? Would you be willing to take on a personal request? I'm worried for the safety of a friend of mine, and would ask you to check on them.

49.original: Thank you. I know you have no shortage of demands on your time. My friend, you see, he's a bit of a private person, and I only wish to know how he is faring after the recent troubles.

50.original: However, the journey to his abode is much too dangerous for me to attempt alone, and I wouldn't dare ask another villager to go in my stead. A traveler with a sharp blade, however, could surely get the task done with little effort.

51.original: He resides in the jungle to the northwest, or at least, he used to. I'll mark the location on your map─his name is Sushena, and if you <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>say<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> his name, he <hex:021A020203>should<hex:021A020103> respond.

52.original: If my worst fears have come to pass and he is wounded, please use this medicine to treat his wounds. You will be rewarded for your efforts, but I suspect you would have helped me even if I had nothing to give in return.

53.original: I've marked the location that Sushena dwells on your map. <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Say<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> his name, and hopefully he will respond in turn.

55.original: With the chat mode in <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Say<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, use your keyboard or the software keyboard to enter any phrase containing the word “Sushena” near the area marked on your map.

56.original: You hear faint sounds of an animal in pain emanating from the direction of the bluffs. Investigate its source.

57.original: The yeti appears to be wounded. Perhaps the medicine provided to you will alleviate its suffering.

59.original: Although you cannot understand the yeti's words, you can sense the gratitude behind them. Return to the young Arkasodara and inform him that his friend is well.

60.original: Welcome back, traveler! So, how was he?

61.original: Oh, that's horrible! Still, I suppose I can be grateful that you could treat his wounds. I owe Sushena my life─when I was attacked by one of those terrible pisaca, Sushena's roar drove the monster off.

62.original: That was the start of our friendship─one I've treasured ever since. But my family has forbidden me from venturing into the woods, so I haven't been able to check up on him. I know they're only worried for my safety, but still...

64.original: You should explain everything to them.

66.original: You're right, of course. Surely if I explain Sushena's bravery and selflessness, they'd understand. I've nothing to lose by trying, anyways!

67.original: Thank you. Not only did you save Sushena, but you've reminded me what true friendship is worth. It's not much, but please, take this!
